newsitem.title: MEXICO: Four women die in Mexican witchcraft rite.
newsitem.headline: Four women die in Mexican witchcraft rite.

text.p: Four Mexican women taking part in a witchcraft ceremony suffocated as they prepared a herbal concoction to drive away evil spirits, officials said on Friday.
Three of the women were found on Thursday choked to death on the floor of a middle-class Mexico City apartment after inhaling a deadly brew of ammonia and smouldering herbs.
A fourth died early on Friday in hospital, said Red Cross Commander Isaac Oxenhaut.

Mexico City authorities said the women died carrying out an "exorcism" of evil spirits. Newspaper reports said the owner of the apartment, Maria de la Luz, 42, had sought to be "cleansed" because she was down on her luck, out of money and thought someone had cast a spell on her.
She was found, along with the sorceress and two other women, by her 13-year-old daughter when she returned from school.
